dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure connectivity in valladolid city

description: CARTIF publishes before-and-after spatial indicators for green-infrastructure accessibility in Valladolid. The free Zenodo deposit provides Shapefile components and XML metadata under CC BY 4.0. EXANTE represents the baseline and EXPOST conditions after UrbanGreenUP interventions. The description measures straight-line separation between population locations and nature-based-solution centroids. These layers can compare assumptions about access to green space in urban infrastructure scenarios. The related first-review draft data-savings-in-treatment-of-stormwater-in-valladolid-city covers a separate stormwater workbook, not these accessibility geometries. Coverage is one city intervention study; exact reference years, population weighting and attribute units remain unknown. Straight-line distance is not a routed walking-time estimate, and the inventory lacks an EXPOST SHX entry, so file completeness needs checking. No spatial layers were downloaded, travel times inferred or project benefits independently verified.
name: Green Infrastructure Connectivity in Valladolid City
